The image successfully captures the complex optical properties of a soap bubble. Deductions are minimal, primarily due to the slight geometric imperfection caused by the side droplet.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifact is the ambiguous fusion of the small droplet on the right edge, lacking crisp refractive boundaries (Severity ~1.5). Secondary issues include slight internal reflection muddiness and minor compression artifacts noted by the PQ Auditor. These are subtle and do not detract significantly from the overall realism, but they prevent a perfect score. The background distortion is largely consistent with spherical refraction, though slightly soft.
